social_media.headline: Renewed Major Geomagnetic Activity Expected
social_media.summary: Major geomagnetic storm is ongoing. Another series of coronal mass ejections is expected to produce renewed G3–G5 activity.
what_we_know: G5 conditions have occurred, and storming remains in progress as of 1230 UTC Saturday.
Renewed storm impacts are expected between 0600 and 1800 UTC Sunday.
There is a 60% chance disturbed conditions will last for an additional 12 hours after renewed impact.

footer.left: Continue heightened operations and follow sector-specific procedures.

visual.alt_text: Operational visualization for ongoing and renewed G3–G5 geomagnetic storm conditions.
